configuration.meaning: simulation ticks; default warmup is 10 simulated seconds and default sample is 60 simulated seconds, not real-time qualification

report.scope: CPU only: deterministic raw-input seam, FlightSession._physics_process then Simulation._physics_process including collision and accepted-step callbacks. Detached session, no render/audio/OS input/scheduler. Durations are simulated ticks, not wall-clock warmup/sample. Hashing, backend and native counter checks run outside per-tick timing and can perturb later ticks; the sample loop wall time includes them. Fingerprint covers types, shapes and numeric simulation arrays at the initial boundary and every warmup and sample tick, not all Session/event/checkpoint state. No Gate P or native frame qualification claim.
